messages.author: 26c7c77e326f196c
messages.subject: Combining/joining genlights
parts:
Hi everyone,
I'm looking to join multiple genlights with the same loci but different individuals.
I looked into gl.join(), but it seems to want both loci and inds the same?

I have simulated two datasets from my sample data using gl.sim.ind(), those two sim datasets were then used to simulate offspring using gl.sim.offspring(), and now I need to combine the 3 sim datasets into a single genlight. Is there a function for this/anyone have a readymade solution?

Thanks in advance,
Deane.

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Combining/joining genlights
parts:
Does not work for the loci meta data but there is an rbind. 

So

rbind(gl1,gl2) should work. 

Followed by a gl.check.compliance. 

Cheers Bernd
